name: Maz + Quiggold Omi
description:
The biggest issue with Maz and her pirates, is that they inherently have low Dmg, and compete with PKHO for heavy hitters. In order to get Maz to be fully functional, you would have to take away from PKHO, while only being able to do Mix planets.
The Quiggold Omi doesn't work with PKHO, so the teams really only share the Attackers, and so often, Maz just comes up short.
The anti revive from Quiggold's Omi would be fantastic for Dathomir Nightsisters, or the LS missions with Medics, but none of them are on Mix planets.
notes: Falls short from having to share Attackers with PKHO
